ErrorResourceURL.description: Only an authorized same-origin API read reference; no query, fragment, credentials or physical path. Runtime authorization remains required.

PublicError.description: Shared safe error for HTTP, Task.error and SSE error payload. HTTP status mapping lives on each variant. Not a complete Task or endpoint contract.

TaskError.description: Error after task acceptance; same public vocabulary, never authorizes retry of the accepted request.

ErrorTaskStatusURL.description: Task status endpoint only. Authorization and task ownership must still be checked at runtime.

MaterialClassificationConfirmedView.description: Successful confirm/correct result. Read projection remains able to represent unconfirmed sources.

MaterialClassificationMutationMeta.description: Completed synchronous classification mutation: earliest deduplication expiry is required and non-null. Actual retention is a runtime obligation.
